evaluation_basis: Assessed for prespecified regime/horizon inference, calibrated selection and robustness diagnostics; a local discovery could not substitute for global replication.
original_objective: Test Funding/Basis/Order Flow/OI across fixed regimes and 4h/12h/24h horizons with calibration, bootstrap/BH, CPCV, PBO and DSR diagnostics.

engineering_result.summary: Point-in-time regimes, nested calibration/threshold selection, non-overlapping horizons, coverage matching and CPCV/PBO/DSR panels executed.

scientific_result.summary: No pooled or long-history family was validated. The recent-panel 4h OI-Bear subset passed a local gate but short history and pooled PBO/DSR weakness required independent confirmation.

economic_result.summary: All pooled variants lost after costs. OI in 219 Bear observations produced 32 trades, +2.97%, Sharpe 1.634 and MDD -4.46% versus matched baseline -13.90%, but was not promoted.

limitations: Conditional subset selection required independent confirmation
contribution_to_next_version: Defined v0.6 cross-sectional 8h funding research and independent OI-Bear confirmation instead of overfitting the local subset.
